extractedItems.question: You hit your ball into some long grass but it’s still in play. What must you do according to the rules?

choices.text: Move the ball to a nicer spot
Play the ball as it lies, without moving it
Touch the ball to clean off the mud
Ask your friend to pick up your ball

extractedItems.explanation: The rule says you must play the ball as it lies unless a specific rule allows you to do something else.
